name: eternities-architect
intent: Convert a consequential system question into an evidenced architecture decision and implementation-ready handoff.
successCondition: The selected design traces to requirements and repository reality, compares viable alternatives, defines interfaces and failure behavior, and terminates with testable acceptance conditions.
positiveTriggers: reconcile an existing architecture with new requirements
make and record a durable architecture decision
negativeTriggers: open-ended ideation without a system decision
implementation of an already approved plan
failureModes: a decision depends on missing owner authority
no viable option meets a critical constraint
terminationConditions: the chosen design traces to requirements and evidence
interfaces, failure behavior, and acceptance conditions are explicit
unresolved decisions and revisit triggers are named
the implementation handoff does not require renewed architecture discovery
